Name: Supersized Bachelors
Author: BitterBosc
Description:
*NOW UPDATED FOR STARDEW VALLEY 1.6*

FEATURING:

NEW SPRITES:
- New bigger and better character and portrait sprites for Alex, Sam, and Shane
- Now including Beach and Winter Sprites

DYNAMIC WEIGHT GAIN:
- Shane, Alex, and Sam grow depending on the number of hearts you have with them
- Or pick a size for them, regardless of hearts

NEW DIALOGUE:
- Huge dialogue overhaul for Alex, Shane, and Sam including marriage, festivals, and events
- Minor dialogue edits for each of the other Pelican Town residents!

NEW FAVORITE GIFTS:
- Alex, Sam, and Shane have new favorites reflecting their insatiable appetites.
- Check out the readme.txt for more information



DISCLAIMER:
- This is my very first experience with modding of any kind, so please excuse any shoddy coding wherever it exists. I am more than open to any advice or criticism so that I can better this mod. Feel free to let me know of any bugs or issues that you come across.

Downloads.Description: New dynamic weight gain featuring Shane, Sam, and Alex. Compatible with version 1.6
